verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.pt: Ora, o Senhor falou a Moisés e a Arão na terra do Egito, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt,

verses.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
verses.pt: Este mês será para vós o princípio dos meses; este vos será o primeiro dos meses do ano.
verses.en_web: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.
verses.en_bbe: Let this month be to you the first of months, the first month of the year.

verses.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
verses.pt: Falai a toda a congregação de Israel, dizendo: Ao décimo dia deste mês tomará cada um para si um cordeiro, segundo as casas dos pais, um cordeiro para cada família.
verses.en_web: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;
verses.en_bbe: Say to all the children of Israel when they are come together, In the tenth day of this month every man is to take a lamb, by the number of their fathers' families, a lamb for every family:

verses.en: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.pt: Mas se a família for pequena demais para um cordeiro, tomá-lo-á juntamente com o vizinho mais próximo de sua casa, conforme o número de almas; conforme ao comer de cada um, fareis a conta para o cordeiro.
verses.en_web: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls; according to what everyone can eat you shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.en_bbe: And if the lamb is more than enough for the family, let that family and its nearest neighbour have a lamb between them, taking into account the number of persons and how much food is needed for every man.

verses.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
verses.pt: O cordeiro, ou cabrito, será sem defeito, macho de um ano, o qual tomareis das ovelhas ou das cabras,
verses.en_web: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep, or from the goats:
verses.en_bbe: Let your lamb be without a mark, a male in its first year: you may take it from among the sheep or the goats:

verses.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
verses.pt: e o guardareis até o décimo quarto dia deste mês; e toda a assembléia da congregação de Israel o matará à tardinha:
verses.en_web: and you shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.
verses.en_bbe: Keep it till the fourteenth day of the same month, when everyone who is of the children of Israel is to put it to death between sundown and dark.

verses.en: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
verses.pt: Tomarão do sangue, e pô-lo-ão em ambos os umbrais e na verga da porta, nas casas em que o comerem.
verses.en_web: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.
verses.en_bbe: Then take some of the blood and put it on the two sides of the door and over the door of the house where the meal is to be taken.

verses.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.pt: E naquela noite comerão a carne assada ao fogo, com pães ázimos; com ervas amargosas a comerao.
verses.en_web: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, and unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.
verses.en_bbe: And let your food that night be the flesh of the lamb, cooked with fire in the oven, together with unleavened bread and bitter-tasting plants.

verses.en: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
verses.pt: Não comereis dele cru, nem cozido em água, mas sim assado ao fogo; a sua cabeça com as suas pernas e com a sua fressura.
verses.en_web: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take it uncooked or cooked with boiling water, but let it be cooked in the oven; its head with its legs and its inside parts.

verses.en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
verses.pt: Nada dele deixareis até pela manhã; mas o que dele ficar até pela manhã, queimá-lo-eis no fogo.
verses.en_web: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep any of it till the morning; anything which is not used is to be burned with fire.

verses.en: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’S passover.
verses.pt: Assim pois o comereis: Os vossos lombos cingidos, os vossos sapatos nos pés, e o vosso cajado na mão; e o comereis apressadamente; esta é a páscoa do Senhor.
verses.en_web: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is Yahweh’s Passover.
verses.en_bbe: And take your meal dressed as if for a journey, with your shoes on your feet and your sticks in your hands: take it quickly: it is the Lord's Passover.

verses.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Porque naquela noite passarei pela terra do Egito, e ferirei todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, tanto dos homens como dos animais; e sobre todos os deuses do Egito executarei juízos; eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. Against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments: I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For on that night I will go through the land of Egypt, sending death on every first male child, of man and of beast, and judging all the gods of Egypt: I am the Lord.

verses.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Mas o sangue vos será por sinal nas casas em que estiverdes; vendo eu o sangue, passarei por cima de vós, e não haverá entre vós praga para vos destruir, quando eu ferir a terra do Egito. :
verses.en_web: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and there shall no plague be on you to destroy you, when I strike the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And the blood will be a sign on the houses where you are: when I see the blood I will go over you, and no evil will come on you for your destruction, when my hand is on the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
verses.pt: E este dia vos será por memorial, e celebrá-lo-eis por festa ao Senhor; através das vossas gerações o celebrareis por estatuto perpétuo.
verses.en_web: This day shall be to you for a memorial, and you shall keep it a feast to Yahweh: throughout your generations you shall keep it a feast by an ordinance forever.
verses.en_bbe: And this day is to be kept in your memories: you are to keep it as a feast to the Lord through all your generations, as an order for ever.

verses.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.pt: Por sete dias comereis pães ázimos; logo ao primeiro dia tirareis o fermento das vossas casas, porque qualquer que comer pão levedado, entre o primeiro e o sétimo dia, esse será cortado de Israel.
verses.en_web: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.en_bbe: For seven days let your food be unleavened bread; from the first day no leaven is to be seen in your houses: whoever takes bread with leaven in it, from the first till the seventh day, will be cut off from Israel.

verses.en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
verses.pt: E ao primeiro dia haverá uma santa convocação; também ao sétimo dia tereis uma santa convocação; neles não se fará trabalho algum, senão o que diz respeito ao que cada um houver de comer; somente isso poderá ser feito por vós.
verses.en_web: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, that only may be done by you.
verses.en_bbe: And on the first day there is to be a holy meeting and on the seventh day a holy meeting; no sort of work may be done on those days but only to make ready what is necessary for everyone's food.

verses.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
verses.pt: Guardareis, pois, a festa dos pães ázimos, porque nesse mesmo dia tirei vossos exércitos da terra do Egito; pelo que guardareis este dia através das vossas gerações por estatuto perpétuo.
verses.en_web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.
verses.en_bbe: So keep the feast of unleavened bread; for on this very day I have taken your armies out of the land of Egypt: this day, then, is to be kept through all your generations by an order for ever.

verses.en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
verses.pt: No primeiro mês, aos catorze dias do mês, à tarde, comereis pães ázimos até vinte e um do mês à tarde.
verses.en_web: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.
verses.en_bbe: In the first month, from the evening of the fourteenth day, let your food be unleavened bread till the evening of the twenty-first day of the month.

verses.en: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
verses.pt: Por sete dias não se ache fermento algum nas vossas casas; porque qualquer que comer pão levedado, esse será cortado da congregação de Israel, tanto o peregrino como o natural da terra.
verses.en_web: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.
verses.en_bbe: For seven days no leaven is to be seen in your houses: for whoever takes bread which is leavened will be cut off from the people of Israel, if he is from another country or if he is an Israelite by birth.

verses.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
verses.pt: Nenhuma coisa levedada comereis; em todas as vossas habitações comereis pães ázimos.
verses.en_web: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”
verses.en_bbe: Take nothing which has leaven in it; wherever you are living let your food be unleavened cakes.

verses.en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
verses.pt: Chamou, pois, Moisés todos os anciãos de Israel, e disse-lhes: Ide e tomai-vos cordeiros segundo as vossas famílias, e imolai a páscoa.
verses.en_web: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses sent for the chiefs of Israel, and said to them, See that lambs are marked out for yourselves and your families, and let the Passover lamb be put to death.

verses.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
verses.pt: Então tomareis um molho de hissopo, embebê-lo-eis no sangue que estiver na bacia e marcareis com ele a verga da porta e os dois umbrais; mas nenhum de vós sairá da porta da sua casa até pela manhã.
verses.en_web: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin; and none of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.
verses.en_bbe: And take some hyssop and put it in the blood in the basin, touching the two sides and the top of the doorway with the blood from the basin; and let not one of you go out of his house till the morning.

verses.en: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor passará para ferir aos egípcios; e, ao ver o sangue na verga da porta e em ambos os umbrais, o Senhor passará aquela porta, e não deixará o destruidor entrar em vossas casas para vos ferir.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will go through the land, sending death on the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the two sides and the top of the door, the Lord will go over your door and will not let death come in for your destruction.

verses.en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
verses.pt: Portanto guardareis isto por estatuto para vós e para vossos filhos, para sempre.
verses.en_web: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to keep this as an order to you and to your sons for ever.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, tiverdes entrado na terra que o Senhor vos dará, como tem prometido, guardareis este culto.
verses.en_web: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, according as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.
verses.en_bbe: And when you come into the land which the Lord will make yours, as he gave his word, you are to keep this act of worship.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
verses.pt: E quando vossos filhos vos perguntarem: Que quereis dizer com este culto?
verses.en_web: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
verses.en_bbe: And when your children say to you, What is the reason of this act of worship?

verses.en: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD’S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
verses.pt: Respondereis: Este é o sacrifício da páscoa do Senhor, que passou as casas dos filhos de Israel no Egito, quando feriu os egípcios, e livrou as nossas casas. Então o povo inclinou-se e adorou.
verses.en_web: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.en_bbe: Then you will say, This is the offering of the Lord's Passover; for he went over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he sent death on the Egyptians, and kept our families safe. And the people gave worship with bent heads.

verses.en: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.pt: E foram os filhos de Israel, e fizeram isso; como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés e a Arão, assim fizeram.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel went and did so; as the Lord had given orders to Moses and Aaron, so they did.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que à meia-noite o Senhor feriu todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, desde o primogênito de Faraó, que se assentava em seu trono, até o primogênito do cativo que estava no cárcere, e todos os primogênitos dos animais.
verses.en_web: At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of livestock.
verses.en_bbe: And in the middle of the night the Lord sent death on every first male child in the land of Egypt, from the child of Pharaoh on his seat of power to the child of the prisoner in the prison; and the first births of all the cattle.

verses.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
verses.pt: E Faraó levantou-se de noite, ele e todos os seus servos, e todos os egípcios; e fez-se grande clamor no Egito, porque não havia casa em que não houvesse um morto.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh got up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians; and a great cry went up from Egypt; for there was not a house where someone was not dead.

verses.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
verses.pt: Então Faraó chamou Moisés e Arão de noite, e disse: Levantai-vos, saí do meio do meu povo, tanto vós como os filhos de Israel; e ide servir ao Senhor, como tendes dito.
verses.en_web: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!
verses.en_bbe: And he sent for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Get up and go out from among my people, you and the children of Israel; go and give worship to the Lord as you have said.

verses.en: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
verses.pt: Levai também convosco os vossos rebanhos e o vosso gado, como tendes dito; e ide, e abençoai-me também a mim.
verses.en_web: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”
verses.en_bbe: And take your flocks and your herds as you have said, and be gone; and give me your blessing.

verses.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
verses.pt: E os egípcios apertavam ao povo, e apressando-se por lançá-los da terra; porque diziam: Estamos todos mortos.
verses.en_web: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Egyptians were forcing the people on, to get them out of the land quickly; for they said, We are all dead men.

verses.en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
verses.pt: Ao que o povo tomou a massa, antes que ela levedasse, e as amassadeiras atadas e em seus vestidos, sobre os ombros.
verses.en_web: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
verses.en_bbe: And the people took their bread-paste before it was leavened, putting their basins in their clothing on their backs.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
verses.pt: Fizeram, pois, os filhos de Israel conforme a palavra de Moisés, e pediram aos egípcios jóias de prata, e jóias de ouro, e vestidos.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel had done as Moses had said; and they got from the Egyptians ornaments of silver and of gold, and clothing:

verses.en: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
verses.pt: E o Senhor deu ao povo graça aos olhos dos egípcios, de modo que estes lhe davam o que pedia; e despojaram aos egipcios.
verses.en_web: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord had given the people grace in the eyes of the Egyptians so that they gave them whatever was requested. So they took away all their goods from the Egyptians.

verses.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
verses.pt: Assim viajaram os filhos de Israel de a Ramessés a Sucote, cerca de seiscentos mil homens de pé, sem contar as crianças.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, besides children.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel made the journey from Rameses to Succoth; there were about six hundred thousand men on foot, as well as children.

verses.en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
verses.pt: Também subiu com eles uma grande mistura de gente; e, em rebanhos e manadas, uma grande quantidade de gado.
verses.en_web: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.
verses.en_bbe: And a mixed band of people went with them; and flocks and herds in great numbers.

verses.en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
verses.pt: E cozeram bolos ázimos da massa que levaram do Egito, porque ela não se tinha levedado, porquanto foram lançados do Egito; e não puderam deter-se, nem haviam preparado comida.
verses.en_web: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.
verses.en_bbe: And they made unleavened cakes from the paste which they had taken out of Egypt; it was not leavened, for they had been sent out of Egypt so quickly, that they had no time to make any food ready.

verses.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
verses.pt: Ora, o tempo que os filhos de Israel moraram no Egito foi de quatrocentos e trinta anos.
verses.en_web: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.
verses.en_bbe: Now the children of Israel had been living in Egypt for four hundred and thirty years.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, ao fim de quatrocentos e trinta anos, naquele mesmo dia, todos os exércitos do Senhor saíram da terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And at the end of four hundred and thirty years, to the very day, all the armies of the Lord went out of the land of Egypt.

verses.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
verses.pt: Esta é uma noite que se deve guardar ao Senhor, porque os tirou da terra do Egito; esta é a noite do Senhor, que deve ser guardada por todos os filhos de Israel através das suas gerações.
verses.en_web: It is a night to be much observed to Yahweh for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of Yahweh, to be much observed of all the children of Israel throughout their generations.
verses.en_bbe: It is a watch-night before the Lord who took them out of the land of Egypt: this same night is a watch-night to the Lord for all the children of Israel, through all their generations.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão: Esta é a ordenança da páscoa; nenhum, estrangeiro comerá dela;
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, This is the law of the Passover: no man who is not an Israelite is to take of it:

verses.en: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
verses.pt: mas todo escravo comprado por dinheiro, depois que o houveres circuncidado, comerá dela.
verses.en_web: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.
verses.en_bbe: But every man's servant, whom he has got for money, may take of it, when he has had circumcision.

verses.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
verses.pt: O forasteiro e o assalariado não comerão dela.
verses.en_web: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.
verses.en_bbe: A man from a strange country living among you, and a servant working for payment, may not take part in it.

verses.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
verses.pt: Numa só casa se comerá o cordeiro; não levareis daquela carne fora da casa nem lhe quebrareis osso algum.
verses.en_web: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.
verses.en_bbe: It is to be taken in one house; not a bit of the flesh is to be taken out of the house, and no bone of it may be broken.

verses.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.pt: Toda a congregação de Israel a observará.
verses.en_web: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.en_bbe: All Israel is to keep the feast.

verses.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
verses.pt: Quando, porém, algum estrangeiro peregrinar entre vós e quiser celebrar a páscoa ao Senhor, circuncidem-se todos os seus varões; então se chegará e a celebrará, e será como o natural da terra; mas nenhum incircunciso comerá dela.
verses.en_web: When a stranger shall live as a foreigner with you, and will keep the Passover to Yahweh, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one who is born in the land: but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man from another country is living with you, and has a desire to keep the Passover to the Lord, let all the males of his family undergo circumcision, and then let him come near and keep it; for he will then be as one of your people; but no one without circumcision may keep it.

verses.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.pt: Haverá uma mesma lei para o natural e para o estrangeiro que peregrinar entre vós.
verses.en_web: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”
verses.en_bbe: The law is the same for him who is an Israelite by birth and for the man from a strange country who is living with you.

verses.en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, fizeram todos os filhos de Israel; como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés e a Arão, assim fizeram.
verses.en_web: All the children of Israel did so. As Yahweh commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
verses.en_bbe: So the children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses and Aaron.

verses.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
verses.pt: E naquele mesmo dia o Senhor tirou os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, segundo os seus exércitos.
verses.en_web: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
verses.en_bbe: And on that very day the Lord took the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
